services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Offering adventure in Whistler since 1985, Backroads is Whistlers only exclusive boat rental operator Find your Whistler boat rentals with Backroads Whistler at Lakeside Park. Dip your paddle in the waters of Alta Lake while spectacular glacier capped mountains and ski hills capture your gaze. Long before there was a Whistler Mountain, Alta Lake was one of the most popular tourist destinations west of the Rockies. For the past 100 years, pioneers and tourists alike have paddled, fished and swam in its clear waters. blurb: Backroads Whistler operates exclusively in lake rentals and guided or self-guided tours down the River of Golden Dreams. They offer a variety of boats suitable for all ages and skill levels, including canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, and pedal boats. The River of Golden Dreams trip is a 3-hour round trip with 2 to 2.5 hours on the water, starting on Alta Lake and then down the river with a shuttle back at the end.
